coordinator#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5nCMZr7AogeWMFqDox

Ruling: letter B · maintainer 「B 币种不同就不填并说明」 · 2026-11-22T06:26Z

The maintainer (Leehom) tapped option B on the decision card in the project's decision thread `cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X7TqENfSw5GjYoqiikiU2Fa` (card `cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XJwJqMxSxEZfD5gen77RE8z`, choice record `cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XQyRrTApgGAXxtfnpSRSP3M`, 2026-11-22T06:26:02Z). It answers the open question of report 7074836167 (item 1 of this card). The option text on the card: 「外币发票单价留空并写明原因,由用户输入;本位币发票不变;一个小 PR。」

**Ruled:** when a pick would copy a money value whose currency differs from the currency of the field it fills, the value is not copied. The cell stays empty and the form says why. A pick between two amounts in the same currency behaves as it does today, so home-currency documents do not change.

Not taken: A (convert at the exchange rate when the product is picked), C (per-currency price rows).

Stated to the maintainer before the tap, with no objection written in the thread: the build-time refusal of a declared pair (B' in the report) is not added. The line's currency is known only at run time, so refusing the declaration would also take the prefill away from home-currency documents.

**Execution (from the decision thread's analysis; items below this line are the thread's reading, not text on the tapped card):**

1. One rule on all three fill paths: the grid's same-named copy, the grid's declared `lookupAutofill` pairs, and the record form's declared pairs, on a pick and on opening. Read at main 8925d5bc: `lookupAutofillPatch` in `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/GridField.tsx:286-302`, `declaredLookupAutofillPatch` called at `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/LookupField.tsx:1204` and `:1245`. The other fields of the same pick (a description) still fill.
2. "Same currency": both sides follow the home currency (neither declares one) counts as the same and copies as today, an organization with no home currency configured included. Otherwise the value copies only when both sides resolve to the same known code. A target that follows its document's currency while the document has none yet is not filled, and the reason says the document has no currency.
3. A `number` source carries no currency and copies as today.
4. The hint names both currencies and shows the source price with its currency, so a person can price the line by hand. Every locale pack gets the sentence.
5. No conversion, no per-currency price, no build-time refusal.
6. The describe of `lookupAutofill` and of the grid column key `autofill` each gain the rule (semantic change, no key added). This narrows shipped behaviour on non-home-currency targets, so it takes the narrowing route and its contract review.
7. Showcase comments and docs that say a pick fills `unit_price` gain "when the currencies match"; seeds are unchanged (each line's price is explicit).
8. Tests pin: a EUR line's pick leaves the price empty with the hint; a USD line's pick fills; the same two cases for a declared pair.
9. Seat `repo:objectstack#4`, area a4-D continues on this card. Item 2 (PR #36293) is unaffected.

A per-currency price is the direction when an app asks for one: it gets its own card then, and this rule stays under it. hotcrm's multi-currency requirement is deferred by the maintainer (hotcrm `docs/requirements/0012-multi-currency.md`), and hotcrm at 5a17e45 has no record-mode money field and no declared pair that copies money, so nothing there changes.

Analysis: `/mnt/project-files/pm-orders/objectstack/36249-decision-analysis.md`.

Governing text: ADR-0144 D5 (a missing rate refuses; a 1:1 rate is a rejected fallback) and its Non-goals (no read-time conversion); `lookupAutofill` describe in `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts`.

Prior rulings read: lookupautofill,autofill,unit_price,currencymode,exchange,price,币种,汇率 → 4 hits; ADR-0006 D3, ADR-0076 D11, ADR-0144 D2, ADR-0144 D8; thread: none; repo: objectstack-ai/objectstack (D2 and D8 read: neither rules on what a pick copies across currencies).
